messages:
sam: quick sync - PoC for sidecar minibatch coordinator to validate deadline dilution and prefetch wins

tanvi: scope the minimal API pls

sam: MVP: request_token(window_hint_ms, tenant) -> token; use_token(token, batch) -> result; release_token(token,reason)

leo: tokens ephemeral in sidecar for PoC. no etcd.

olivia: client fallback if token request times out - avoid blocking tails

sam: client policy: timeout X ms -> fallback to degraded model, increment tenant timeout metric

tanvi: observability: token_id in traces, per-token histograms, acquire/abort reasons, prefetch success rate

leo: fairness: sidecar keeps tenant->credits map, decrement on acquire, local allocator replenishes credits

olivia: prefetch hook returns boolean for warmup success; if false, caller can skip KV-heavy work

sam: rollout: feature-flag on dev nodes, 1 week metrics, iterate on TTL/heartbeat

canary-bot: canary launched: sidecar-batcher v0.1 -> nodeset "batch-proof-1" (5 nodes)

sam: next steps - sam+leo implement sidecar, olivia dashboards + client breaker, tanvi coordinates canary

tanvi: add debug endpoint to inspect tokens and credits for on-call

sam: will post short RFC with API + checklist here when ready

leo: long-term options: keep sidecars + aggregator or switch to central token store with lease semantics; decide after metrics

olivia: :thumbsup:
